title: Product
description: One product, one directory. See CONTENT.md for why each field exists.

id.description: Slug. Appears in URLs and import/export. Never rename a published one.

name.description: Proper noun. The same in both languages, so it is not localized.

tagline.description: One line. What it is, for someone who will read one line.

summary.description: Two or three sentences. Shown on the deck and at the top of the detail page.

category.description: What it is. Declared in product/catalog.json.

stage.description: How far it is. Ordered: concept < alpha < beta < stable < retired.

version.description: The released number, without the leading v. Omit before the first release.

notice.description: One caveat next to the stage, e.g. 'runs, but not for production'.

highlights.description: What it does, in the order a reader should meet it. The deck shows the first four.

facts.description: License, engine, language, deployment — the short answers people ask first. Free-form labels, unique per product.

kind.description: repo is the primary action; the rest are listed under it.

research.description: Research topic ids that led to this product. Declared here, once; the topic does not point back.

order.description: Where it sits on the deck, lowest first. Ties fall back to the name.
